# Handlyr — NYC Handyman Service

> Handlyr is a professional, owner-operated handyman service in New York City,
> serving Brooklyn, Queens, and Manhasset (North Shore, Nassau County). Run by
> Serge, with 15+ years of hands-on experience (in business since 2009). Known
> for fast response, clean work, and fair, upfront pricing. Free estimates —
> text a photo of the job for a quote.

## Contact
- Phone / Text: (347) 799-8402
- Email: order@handlyr.org
- Website: https://handlyr.org
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (same-day appointments often available)
- How to get a quote: Text a photo of the job to (347) 799-8402; reply usually within the hour. Estimates are free with no obligation.

## Service Areas
- Brooklyn, NY — Park Slope, Williamsburg, DUMBO, Bay Ridge, Flatbush, Crown Heights, Bed-Stuy, Sunset Park: https://handlyr.org/service-areas/brooklyn
- Queens, NY — Long Island City, Astoria, Sunnyside, Forest Hills, Flushing, Jackson Heights, Jamaica, Bayside: https://handlyr.org/service-areas/queens
- Manhasset, NY — Plandome, Munsey Park, Flower Hill, Strathmore, Manhasset Hills (North Shore, Nassau County): https://handlyr.org/service-areas/manhasset

## Services
- Furniture assembly (IKEA, Wayfair, West Elm, Amazon, CB2 and all flat-pack): https://handlyr.org/services/furniture-assembly
- TV mounting — all wall types incl. drywall, concrete, brick, tile, plaster; cable management included: https://handlyr.org/services/tv-mounting
- Shelf installation — floating, bracket, IKEA systems (KALLAX, Billy), built-ins: https://handlyr.org/services/shelf-installation
- Blinds & window treatment installation — roller/cellular/venetian/roman shades, curtain rods: https://handlyr.org/services/blinds-installation
- Cabinet installation — kitchen, bathroom vanity, medicine, storage cabinets: https://handlyr.org/services/cabinet-installation
- Drywall repair — holes, cracks, water damage; smooth, paint-ready finish: https://handlyr.org/services/drywall-repair
- General handyman repairs — doors, hinges, faucets, fixtures, picture hanging, punch lists: https://handlyr.org/services/general-repairs
